title: Recovery of an indexed Boolean function
statement: Let $N$ be a natural number, and let $q$ assign a Boolean value to each of the $2^N$ indices. Define a sign-valued function on the $N$-dimensional sign cube by reading $q$ at the index corresponding to each sign vector and converting its Boolean value to a sign. If this function is converted back to an indexed Boolean function by evaluating it at the sign vector corresponding to each index and converting the sign back to a Boolean value, the result is exactly $q$.
hypotheses_covered: A Boolean-valued function on the $2^N$ indices
